title: Personalized Basketball Above Hoop Close Up Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the energy of the court into your bedroom with this personalized basketball comforter set from Jeminise. Perfect for basketball players and sports fans, this custom bedding set allows you to feature your own name and number, creating a unique and personal bedroom space.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own Name and Number to make a truly unique sports-themed bedding set.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling that prevents clumping or shifting.
  • Durable & Vibrant: Utilizes advanced environmental protection dyeing techniques that hold color tightly and prevent fading over time.
  • All-Season Comfort: Lightweight, soft, and breathable material makes this comforter set perfect for comfortable use in any season.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on low or air dry to return to its fluffy texture.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Fill Material Microfiber
Selected Design Basketball D016
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Decor
Theme Watercolor
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
